description: This file defines the internal class SiloManifestProvider responsible for creating and managing the Silo's manifest, including grain properties and interface metadata in an Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: SiloManifestProvider
classes.description: Internal class responsible for generating the silo's grain and interface manifests based on provided configurations and type resolvers.

methods.name: SiloManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manifest provider with various grain and interface property providers, options, and resolvers.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Creates an immutable dictionary of GrainInterfaceType to GrainInterfaceProperties, populating from interface providers.

methods.name: CreateGrainManifest
methods.description: Creates tuples of grain type to grain properties and grain type to grain class mappings.
